blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has elevated wildfire prevention to maximum alert status nationwide as the onset of a “Very Strong” El Niño triggers extreme heat and severe vegetation drying across grasslands and forests.
